name: Data Oz Solutions
summary: Nationwide dialup + ADSL + phone ISP (dataozsolutions.com.au); retail 2008-2011, parked by 2012.

events.details: "Premium nationwide ISP" offering dialup + high-speed access; earliest Wayback capture 29 Jan 2008 (no evidence found for the previously claimed 1996 founding).
Retail site ("Providers of quality Internet packages") active through Feb 2011; a Parallels Plesk "Domain Default page" (parked) by Feb 2012; an Apache directory index by 2016.
